info.title: Ordinary customer business discovery
info.description: Short idea/no-idea conversation and versioned flexible business/acquisition/tools report. No creation or site before explicit exact-report approval. Uses existing verified customer session/own portfolio; strict body16KiB, durable idempotency and base revision CAS. A ready plan requires two independent role reviews; source/model/tool claims are not independently verified operations. Build approval creates exactly one existing shared creation job, with the full immutable approved report in server context. This first source adapter does not itself certify full website foundation, designer, agents, calibration or public launch. Archives remove test creations from active listing, cancel pending dispatch and retain all history/accounting; own detail/history remains accessible. Held live channels and costs remain separate.
